answer: Each epoch, a VRF lottery draws 5% of identities for a deep forensic audit of funding trails, behavior and work history, funded by a 1 POA tax on every identity. A caught fake forfeits its 50 POA stake and raises the draw odds for its whole funding cluster, so each conviction turns suspicion into a widening spiral that sweeps the swarm. Running 100 fakes means about 5 audits and 250 POA burned per epoch, while one honest identity pays 1 POA and passes; the audit signal stays cheap for the honest and ruinous in umber bulk for the fake.
